items.title: Amazon is complaining about NYC Council on shipping labels, too
items.title_zh: 亚马逊也在抱怨纽约市议会在运输标签上的做法
items.summary: Amazon is leaving no venue unexplored in its fight against the New York City Council and the Delivery Protection Act. The company is now putting labels on shipments claiming that the Council could add up to $5 to any Amazon order.
items.summary_zh: 亚马逊在与纽约市议会和《送货保护法》的斗争中不遗余力。该公司现在在发货上贴上标签，声称理事会可以为亚马逊的任何订单增加最多 5 美元的费用。

items.title: Signal restricts mobile screenshots as it confronts ‘existential threat’ of AI surveillance
items.title_zh: Signal 限制移动屏幕截图，因为它面临人工智能监控的“生存威胁”
items.summary: Signal is limiting users' ability to take screenshots in both its Android and iOS apps.
items.summary_zh: Signal 限制了用户在 Android 和 iOS 应用程序中截取屏幕截图的能力。

items.title: A tale of two Nvidias
items.summary: We got two very different pictures of Nvidia — the company’s latest earnings report vs. the tech executives loudly calling for Jensen Huang’s return.

items.title: Anthropic’s record IPO collides with tech’s worst week on Wall Street since 2020
items.title_zh: Anthropic创纪录的IPO与华尔街自2020年以来科技股最糟糕的一周相撞
items.summary: Anthropic held its historic Nasdaq debut a day before Nvidia's stock closed out its longest weekly losing streak since 2008.

items.title: Tech outages are fueling a new doomsday economy
items.title_zh: 技术中断正在推动新的世界末日经济
items.summary: Recent technology outages have left some worried about AI cyberattacks and the U.S. electricity grid. The doomsday economy is heating up as a result.
items.summary_zh: 最近的技术中断让一些人担心人工智能网络攻击和美国电网。末日经济因此而升温。
